title: Base Instance
$comment: SCOPE: structure only — field presence, types, enum membership, ranges, nullability. No cross-field logic is enforced here; that lives in validators/ (later task, with unit tests). Rules recorded but NOT implemented by this schema: (6) hi_variant_collapsed on a derived record may be true only when this base's pii[].type is one of the six non-transliterable categories (PHONE, EMAIL, PAN, AADHAAR, UPI_ID, BANK_ACCOUNT) per guidelines.md §4.3 — not checkable from the base instance alone. (7) address_structure must be non-null iff an ADDRESS entry is present in pii[] (guidelines.md §7.3 / PROJECT_SPEC.md §13). (11) BASE_KIND INVARIANT (v0.3, resolves OQ-003, guidelines.md §13.4): base_kind == POSITIVE implies len(pii) >= 1; base_kind == HARD_NEGATIVE implies len(pii) == 0. Enforced by validators/base_kind.py, not by this schema. base_id naming conventions (e.g. a NEG_ prefix) must NEVER be used to infer base_kind — base_kind is the sole, explicit discriminator. OQ-002 is resolved: hard-negative bases ARE base_instance objects (pii: [], base_kind: HARD_NEGATIVE); distractor information belongs only on the derived record (guidelines.md §13.3), never on the base instance — additionalProperties: false on this schema already excludes a distractors field here. RESOLVED (v0.9, OQ-020): generator_version added as a required field, identical name/pattern to schemas/example.schema.json's own generator_version — no new field name or versioning convention invented. RESOLVED (OQ-021): no address_deva / ADDRESS-equivalent of person_context.name_deva was added to this schema — ADDRESS's Devanagari form is generated at record-derivation time (T08) as realized_pii_value, never cached on the base instance; person_context.name_deva remains the only stored base-level Devanagari field. RESOLVED (v0.16, OQ-046, guidelines.md §13.12): hard_negative_decoy added as an OPTIONAL property (not in `required`) — construction-level ground truth for a HARD_NEGATIVE base's single decoy, persisted here because pii[] must stay empty for HARD_NEGATIVE (decision 16) and provides nowhere else to carry it. Present-and-populated iff base_kind == HARD_NEGATIVE; absent or null iff base_kind == POSITIVE — that relationship is cross-field and is enforced by validators/base_kind.py, not by this schema, consistent with the base_kind/pii invariant's own precedent immediately above. This field does NOT change the distractors-belong-only-on-the-derived-record rule: hard_negative_decoy is singular, base-instance-level construction ground truth; distractors[] on the derived record is what Phase 2 materializes from it.

base_id.description: Permanent, never reused. E.g. PAN_001, NEG_007 (PROJECT_SPEC.md §12.2). Naming pattern carries no semantic meaning — never used to infer base_kind (guidelines.md §13.4).

base_pii_value.description: Canonical form. Never changes across derived-record variants (guidelines.md §4.4).

name_deva.description: Deterministic transliteration, fixed at base-instance creation (guidelines.md §4.5).

generator_version.description: Same field, name, and pattern as schemas/example.schema.json's generator_version (resolves OQ-020) — one toolchain version number, covering PII generation (T03), base-instance assembly (T04), and the transliteration table (T07). PROJECT_SPEC.md §8.3 / guidelines.md §4.5: the transliteration table's version is recorded here, not in a separate field.

value.description: The decoy's realized value, e.g. '9876543210' or 'rahul4521@corp' (guidelines.md §13.8). Not a PII value — never checked against any pii_type structural rule.

hard_negative_decoy.description: OPTIONAL. Construction-level ground truth for a HARD_NEGATIVE base's single decoy (guidelines.md §13.12, resolves OQ-046). NOT in this schema's top-level `required` array — its presence/nullity is governed by base_kind, a cross-field rule enforced by validators/base_kind.py, not by this schema (same scope split as the base_kind/pii invariant). Not required globally so the 100 existing POSITIVE bases remain valid without it.

base_kind.description: Explicit base-level discriminator (guidelines.md §13.4, resolves OQ-003). The pii-cardinality invariant this implies is cross-field and enforced by validators/base_kind.py, not by this schema.

decoy_class.description: Must match schemas/example.schema.json's decoy_class enum exactly (same cross-schema duplication convention as generator_version, resolves OQ-020) — this schema does not $ref across files, consistent with how no schema in this repository does.
